verses.uthmani: الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.indopak: الۤرٰ تِلۡكَ اٰيٰتُ الۡـكِتٰبِ وَقُرۡاٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
verses.transliteration: ﻿aliflamra tilka ayatu alkitabi waquranin mubeenin
verses.saheeh: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur'an.
verses.khattab: Alif-Lãm-Ra. These are the verses of the Book; the clear Quran
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Alif lām rā’: God knows best what He means by these [letters]. Those — these verses — are the verses of the Book, the Qur'an (āyātu’l-kitābi: this annexation functions in the sense of min, ‘from’) and of a manifest Qur'an, one that makes evident what is truth and what is falsehood (wa-qur'anin mubīnin is [made up of] a supplement with an added adjectival qualification).
verses.romanUrdu: Alif Laam Raa .. yeh aayat hain kitab e ilahi aur Quran e mubeen ki

verses.uthmani: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
verses.indopak: رُبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لَوۡ كَانُوۡا مُسۡلِمِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: rubama yawaddu allatheena kafaroo law kanoo muslimeena
verses.saheeh: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.
verses.khattab: ˹The day will come when˺ the disbelievers will certainly wish they had submitted ˹to Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿It may be that (read rubbamā or rubamā) those who disbelieve, on the Day of Resurrection, when they witness their predicament and that of the Muslims, will wish that they had been muslims (rubba here is used to indicate ‘many’, since many of them will wish this; but it is also said to indicate ‘few’, since they will be so stupefied by the terrors that they will not come out of their stupor to wish such a thing, except on a few occasions:
verses.romanUrdu: Baeed nahin ke ek waqt woh aa jaye jab wahi log jinhon ne aaj ( dawah e Islam ko qabool karne se) inkar kardiya hai pachta pachta kar kahenge ke kaash humne sar e tasleem kham kardiya hota

verses.uthmani: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.indopak: ذَرۡهُمۡ يَاۡكُلُوۡا وَيَتَمَتَّعُوۡا وَيُلۡهِهِمُ الۡاَمَلُ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: tharhum yakuloo wayatamatta'oo wayulhihimu alamalu fasawfa ya'lamoona
verses.saheeh: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.
verses.khattab: ˹So˺ let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by ˹false˺ hope, for they will soon know
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Leave them, the disbelievers, O Muhammad (s), to eat and to enjoy, this world of theirs, and that they be diverted, distracted, by hope, of a long life and other [such] matters, [that keep them] away from faith, for they will come to know, the sequel of their affair — this was [revealed] before the command to fight [them].
verses.romanUrdu: Chodo inhein khayein (eat) , peeyain (drink) mazey karein aur behlawe mein daale rahey inko jhooti umeed. Anqareeb inehin maloom ho jayega

verses.uthmani: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
verses.indopak: وَمَاۤ اَهۡلَـكۡنَا مِنۡ قَرۡيَةٍ اِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعۡلُوۡمٌ
verses.transliteration: wama ahlakna min qaryatin illa walaha kitabun ma'loomun
verses.saheeh: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.
verses.khattab: We have never destroyed a society without a destined term
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We did not destroy any town (min qaryatin: min is extra), meaning, its inhabitants, but that it had a known decree, a [pre-]determined term, after which it would be destroyed.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne issey pehle jis basti ko bhi halaak kiya hai uske liye ek khaas mohlat e amal likhi jaa chuki thi

verses.uthmani: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
verses.indopak: مَا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَاْخِرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: ma tasbiqu min ommatin ajalaha wama yastakhiroona
verses.saheeh: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.
verses.khattab: No people can advance their doom, nor can they delay it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿No community (min ummatin: min is extra) can outstrip its [predetermined] term nor can they [seek to] delay it, [nor can they] put it off.
verses.romanUrdu: Koi qaum na apne waqt e muqarrar se pehle halaak ho sakti hai, na uske baad chooth sakti hai

verses.uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
verses.indopak: وَ قَالُوۡا يٰۤاَيُّهَا الَّذِىۡ نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ الذِّكۡرُ اِنَّكَ لَمَجۡنُوۡنٌ ؕ
verses.transliteration: waqaloo ya ayyuha allathee nuzzila 'alayhi alththikru innaka lamajnoonun
verses.saheeh: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.
verses.khattab: They say, “O you to whom the Reminder is revealed! You must be insane
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they, that is, the disbelievers of Mecca, say, to the Prophet (s): ‘O you, to whom the Remembrance, the Qur'an — as you claim — has been revealed, lo! you are indeed possessed!
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh log kehte hain “Aey woh shaks jis par zikr nazil hua hai, tu yaqeenan deewana hai

verses.uthmani: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.indopak: لَوۡ مَا تَاۡتِيۡنَا بِالۡمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةِ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: law ma tateena bialmalaikati in kunta mina alssadiqeena
verses.saheeh: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"
verses.khattab: Why do you not bring us the angels, if what you say is true?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Why do you not bring us the angels, if you are of the truthful?’, in saying that you are a prophet and that this Qur'an is from God.
verses.romanUrdu: Agar tu saccha hai to hamare samne Farishton ko le kyun nahin aata?”

verses.uthmani: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًۭا مُّنظَرِينَ
verses.indopak: مَا نُنَزِّلُ الۡمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةَ اِلَّا بِالۡحَـقِّ وَمَا كَانُوۡۤا اِذًا مُّنۡظَرِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: ma nunazzilu almalaikata illa bialhaqqi wama kanoo ithan munthareena
verses.saheeh: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and the disbelievers would not then be reprieved.
verses.khattab: We do not send the angels down except for a just cause, and then ˹the end of˺ the disbelievers will not be delayed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God, exalted be He, says: The angels do not descend (tanazzalu: one of the two tā’ letters [of tatanazzalu] has been omitted) save with the truth, with the chastisement; and then, that is, upon the descent of the angels with the chastisement, they [the disbelievers] would not be reprieved, [would not] be granted respite.
verses.romanUrdu: Hum Farishton ko yunhi nahin utaar diya karte, woh jab utarte hain to haqq ke saath utarte hain, aur phir logon ko mohlat nahin di jati

verses.uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا الذِّكۡرَ وَاِنَّا لَهٗ لَحٰـفِظُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: inna nahnu nazzalna alththikra wainna lahu lahafithoona
verses.saheeh: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Qur'an and indeed, We will be its guardian.
verses.khattab: It is certainly We Who have revealed the Reminder, and it is certainly We Who will preserve it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Verily it is We (nahnu emphasises the subject of inna, or [functions as] a separating pronoun) Who have revealed the Remembrance, the Qur'an, and assuredly We will preserve it, against substitution, distortion, additions and omissions.
verses.romanUrdu: Raha yeh zikr, to isko humne nazil kiya hai aur hum khud iske nigehbaan hain

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.indopak: وَلَـقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ فِىۡ شِيَعِ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: walaqad arsalna min qablika fee shiya'i alawwaleena
verses.saheeh: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muhammad], among the sects of the former peoples.
verses.khattab: Indeed, We sent messengers before you ˹O Prophet˺ among the groups of early peoples
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We sent before you, messengers, to former factions, sects.
verses.romanUrdu: (Aey Muhammad), hum tumse pehle bahut si guzri hui qaumon mein Rasool bhej chuke hain

verses.uthmani: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.indopak: وَمَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: wama yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona
verses.saheeh: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.
verses.khattab: but no messenger ever came to them without being mocked
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And never did a messenger come to them but that they mocked him, in the same way that your people have mocked you — this is meant to comfort the Prophet (s).
verses.romanUrdu: Kabhi aisa nahin hua ke unke paas koi Rasool aaya ho aur unhone uska mazaak na udaya ho

verses.uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.indopak: كَذٰلِكَ نَسۡلُكُهٗ فِىۡ قُلُوۡبِ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: kathalika naslukuhu fee quloobi almujrimeena
verses.saheeh: Thus do We insert denial into the hearts of the criminals.
verses.khattab: This is how We allow disbelief ˹to steep˺ into the hearts of the wicked
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Thus We cause it to find its way, in other words, in the same way that We have caused denial to enter the hearts of those [individuals], We cause it to enter, into the hearts of the sinners, that is, the disbelievers of Mecca.
verses.romanUrdu: Mujrimeen ke dilon mein to hum is zikr ko isi tarah [salaakh ke manind(like a rod)] guzarte hain

verses.uthmani: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.indopak: لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهٖ ۚ وَقَدۡ خَلَتۡ سُنَّةُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: la yuminoona bihi waqad khalat sunnatu alawwaleena
verses.saheeh: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.
verses.khattab: They would not believe in this ˹Quran˺ despite the ˹many˺ examples of those ˹destroyed˺ before
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They do not believe in him, in the Prophet (s), even though the example of the men of old has already gone before, that is, the way of God [in dealing] with them [those of old], by chastising them for denying [the truthfulness of] their prophets: those [Meccans] are like these former.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh ispar iman nahin laya karte. Qadeem (ancient times) se is qumash ke logon ka yahi tareeqa chala aa raha hai

verses.uthmani: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَوۡ فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ بَابًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوۡا فِيۡهِ يَعۡرُجُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: walaw fatahna 'alayhim baban mina alssamai fathalloo feehi ya'rujoona
verses.saheeh: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,
verses.khattab: And even if We opened for them a gate to heaven, through which they continued to ascend
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And even if We were to open for them a gate from the heaven, and they were to continue ascending through it, the gate,
verses.romanUrdu: Agar hum unpar aasman ka koi darwaza khol detay aur woh din dahade usmein chadhne bhi lagte

verses.uthmani: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌۭ مَّسْحُورُونَ
verses.indopak: لَـقَالُوۡۤا اِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتۡ اَبۡصَارُنَا بَلۡ نَحۡنُ قَوۡمٌ مَّسۡحُوۡرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: laqaloo innama sukkirat absaruna bal nahnu qawmun mashooroona
verses.saheeh: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."
verses.khattab: still they would say, “Our eyes have truly been dazzled! In fact, we must have been bewitched.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿they would say, ‘It is merely that our eyes have been dazzled, they have been shut. Nay, we are a folk bewitched!’, imagining this.
verses.romanUrdu: tab bhi woh yahi kehte ke hamari aankhon ko dhoka ho raha hai, balke humpar jaadu kardiya gaya hai

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًۭا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
verses.indopak: وَلَـقَدۡ جَعَلۡنَا فِى السَّمَآءِ بُرُوۡجًا وَّزَيَّـنّٰهَا لِلنّٰظِرِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: walaqad ja'alna fee alssamai buroojan wazayyannaha lilnnathireena
verses.saheeh: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.
verses.khattab: Indeed, We have placed constellations in the sky, and adorned it for all to see
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We have placed in the heaven constellations, twelve [of them]: Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo (al-sunbula), Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius and Pisces, which are the mansions of the seven orbiting planets: Mars rules Aries and Scorpio, Venus: Taurus and Libra, Mercury: Gemini and Virgo, the Moon: Cancer, the Sun: Leo, Jupiter: Sagittarius and Pisces, and Saturn: Capricorn and Aquarius; and We have adorned it, with [these] planets, for beholders;
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh hamari kaar-farmayi hai ke aasman mein humne bahut se mazboot qiley (fortified spheres) banaye, unko dekhne walon ke liye muzayyan (adorn) kiya

verses.uthmani: وَحَفِظْنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍ
verses.indopak: وَحَفِظۡنٰهَا مِنۡ كُلِّ شَيۡطٰنٍ رَّجِيۡمٍ ۙ
verses.transliteration: wahafithnaha min kulli shaytanin rajeemin
verses.saheeh: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allah]
verses.khattab: And We protected it from every accursed devil
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and We have guarded them, with meteors, from every outcast devil;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur har shaytaan e mardood se unko mehfooz kardiya

verses.uthmani: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.indopak: اِلَّا مَنِ اسۡتَرَقَ السَّمۡعَ فَاَ تۡبَعَهٗ شِهَابٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
verses.transliteration: illa mani istaraqa alssam'a faatba'ahu shihabun mubeenun
verses.saheeh: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.
verses.khattab: except the one eavesdropping, who is then pursued by a visible flare
verses.jalalayn: ﻿except the one who listens by stealth — he is pursued by a clear flame, a shining meteor that burns him, or pierces him or drives him insane.
verses.romanUrdu: Koi shaytaan in mein raah nahin paa sakta, illa yeh ke kuch sun-gun le le, aur jab woh sun-gun lene ki koshish karta hai to ek shola roshan uska peecha karta hai

verses.uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مَّوْزُونٍۢ
verses.indopak: وَالۡاَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنٰهَا وَاَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيۡهَا رَوَاسِىَ وَاَنۡۢبَتۡنَا فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ مَّوۡزُوۡنٍ
verses.transliteration: waalarda madadnaha waalqayna feeha rawasiya waanbatna feeha min kulli shayin mawzoonin
verses.saheeh: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.
verses.khattab: As for the earth, We spread it out and placed upon it firm mountains, and caused everything to grow there in perfect balance
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And the earth We have stretched it out, spread it flat, and cast therein firm mountains, lest it should sway beneath its inhabitants, and caused to grow therein every kind of balanced thing, [every kind of thing] known and determined.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne zameen ko phaylaya, us mein pahadh jamaye, usmein har naw ki nabataat theek theek napi tuli miqdar(measure) ke saath ugayi

verses.uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
verses.indopak: وَجَعَلۡنَا لَـكُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَعَايِشَ وَمَنۡ لَّسۡتُمۡ لَهٗ بِرٰزِقِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: waja'alna lakum feeha ma'ayisha waman lastum lahu biraziqeena
verses.saheeh: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.
verses.khattab: And We made in it means of sustenance for you and others, who you do not provide for
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We have made for you therein [means of] livelihood (read ma‘āyish), such as fruits and grains, and, We have made [this] for you, those for whom you do not provide, such as servants, [crawling] creatures and cattle; it is God Who provides for them.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur is mein maishat ke asbaab faraham kiye, tumhare liye bhi aur un bahut si makhlooqat ke liye bhi jinke raziq tum nahin ho

verses.uthmani: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
verses.indopak: وَاِنۡ مِّنۡ شَىۡءٍ اِلَّا عِنۡدَنَا خَزَآٮِٕنُهٗ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهٗۤ اِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعۡلُوۡمٍ
verses.transliteration: wain min shayin illa 'indana khazainuhu wama nunazziluhu illa biqadarin ma'loomin
verses.saheeh: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known measure.
verses.khattab: There is not any means ˹of sustenance˺ whose reserves We do not hold, only bringing it forth in precise measure
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And there is not a thing but that the stores thereof, the keys to its stores, are with Us, and We do not send it down except in a known measure, according to the benefits [of all creatures].
verses.romanUrdu: Koi cheez aisi nahin jiske khazane hamare paas na hon, aur jis cheez ko bhi hum nazil karte hain ek muqarrar miqdar(measure) mein nazil karte hain

verses.uthmani: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ
verses.indopak: وَاَرۡسَلۡنَا الرِّيٰحَ لَوَاقِحَ فَاَنۡزَلۡنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَاَسۡقَيۡنٰكُمُوۡهُ ۚ وَمَاۤ اَنۡتُمۡ لَهٗ بِخٰزِنِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: waarsalna alrriyaha lawaqiha faanzalna mina alssamai maan faasqaynakumoohu wama antum lahu bikhazineena
verses.saheeh: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.
verses.khattab: We send fertilizing winds, and bring down rain from the sky for you to drink. It is not you who hold its reserves
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We send the winds as fertilisers, to fertilise the clouds, whereupon they fill up with water, and send down out of the heaven, [out of] the clouds, water, rain, so that We give it to you to drink, for you are not the storers thereof, that is, the stores thereof are not in your control.
verses.romanUrdu: Baar-awar hawaon (fertilizing winds) ko hum hi bhejte hain, phir aasman se pani barsate hain, aur us pani se tumhein sairaab karte hain, is daulat ke khazana-daar tum nahin ho

wbw.translation: and We gave it to you to drink

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
verses.indopak: وَ اِنَّا لَــنَحۡنُ نُحۡىٖ وَنُمِيۡتُ وَنَحۡنُ الۡوٰرِثُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: wainna lanahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wanahnu alwarithoona
verses.saheeh: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.
verses.khattab: Surely it is We Who give life and cause death. And We are the ˹Eternal˺ Successor
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed it is We Who give life and bring death, and We are the heirs, Who shall endure, inheriting all creation.
verses.romanUrdu: Zindagi aur maut hum dete hain, aur hum hi sab ke waris honay waley hain

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
verses.indopak: وَلَـقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا الۡمُسۡتَقۡدِمِيۡنَ مِنۡكُمۡ وَلَـقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا الۡمُسۡتَـاْخِرِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: walaqad 'alimna almustaqdimeena minkum walaqad 'alimna almustakhireena
verses.saheeh: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].
verses.khattab: We certainly know those who have gone before you and those who will come after ˹you˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We know the predecessors among you, that is, those creatures from Adam who have already passed, and verily We know the successors, those who will come afterwards, until the Day of Resurrection.
verses.romanUrdu: Pehle jo log tum mein se ho guzre hain unko bhi humne dekh rakkha hai, aur baad ke aaney waley bhi hamari nigaah mein hain

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
verses.indopak: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡ ؕ اِنَّهٗ حَكِيۡمٌ عَلِيۡمٌ
verses.transliteration: wainna rabbaka huwa yahshuruhum innahu hakeemun 'aleemun
verses.saheeh: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.
verses.khattab: Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ will gather them together ˹for judgment˺. He is truly All-Wise, All-Knowing
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And it is indeed your Lord Who will gather them, lo! He is Wise, in His actions, Knower, of His creatures.
verses.romanUrdu: Yaqeenan tumhara Rubb in sabko ikattha karega, woh hakeem(All-Wise) bhi hai aur aleem(All-Knowing) bhi

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
verses.indopak: وَلَـقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنۡ صَلۡصَالٍ مِّنۡ حَمَاٍ مَّسۡنُوۡنٍ ۚ
verses.transliteration: walaqad khalaqna alinsana min salsalin min hamain masnoonin
verses.saheeh: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.
verses.khattab: Indeed, We created man from sounding clay moulded from black mud
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We created man, Adam, out of a dry [clinking] clay, that gives off a clinking sound when it is tapped, of malleable mud, black [mud].
verses.romanUrdu: Humne Insaan ko sadi (rotten) hui mitti ke sookhey gaarey (clay) se banaya

verses.uthmani: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verses.indopak: وَالۡجَـآنَّ خَلَقۡنٰهُ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ مِنۡ نَّارِ السَّمُوۡمِ
verses.transliteration: waaljanna khalaqnahu min qablu min nari alssamoomi
verses.saheeh: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.
verses.khattab: As for the jinn, We created them earlier from smokeless fire
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And the jānn, the father of the jinn, namely, Iblīs, We created beforehand — that is, before the creation of Adam — out of the permeative fire, a smokeless fire that can escape through openings.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur ussey pehle Jinno ko hum aag ki lapat se paida kar chuke thay

verses.uthmani: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
verses.indopak: وَاِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةِ اِنِّىۡ خَالـِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّنۡ صَلۡصَالٍ مِّنۡ حَمَاٍ مَّسۡنُوۡنٍ
verses.transliteration: waith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min salsalin min hamain masnoonin
verses.saheeh: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.
verses.khattab: ˹Remember, O Prophet˺ when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from sounding clay moulded from black mud
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And, mention, when your Lord said to the angels, ‘Indeed I am going to create a mortal out of a dry clay [drawn] from a malleable mud.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir yaad karo us mauqe ko jab tumhare Rubb ne Farishton se kaha ke “ main sadi hui mitti ke sookhey gaarey se ek bashar paida kar raha hoon

verses.uthmani: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
verses.indopak: فَاِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهٗ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيۡهِ مِنۡ رُّوۡحِىۡ فَقَعُوۡا لَهٗ سٰجِدِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqa'oo lahu sajideena
verses.saheeh: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
verses.khattab: So when I have fashioned him and had a spirit of My Own ˹creation˺ breathed into him, fall down in prostration to him.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So, when I have proportioned him, completed him, and breathed, caused to flow, of My Spirit in him, so that he becomes a living thing — the annexation of ‘the Spirit’ to him is a conferring of honour upon Adam — fall down in prostration before him!’, a prostration [meant as an act] of salutation by bowing.
verses.romanUrdu: Jab main usey poora bana chukun aur us mein apni rooh se kuch phoonk doon to tum sab uske aagey sajde mein gir jana”

verses.uthmani: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
verses.indopak: فَسَجَدَ الۡمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ اَجۡمَعُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajma'oona
verses.saheeh: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
verses.khattab: So the angels prostrated all together—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And so the angels prostrated, all of them together (kulluhum ajma‘ūn contains two elements of emphasis),
verses.romanUrdu: Chunanchey tamaam Farishton ne sajda kiya

verses.uthmani: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
verses.indopak: اِلَّاۤ اِبۡلِيۡسَ ؕ اَبٰٓى اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنَ مَعَ السّٰجِدِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: illa ibleesa aba an yakoona ma'a alssajideena
verses.saheeh: Except Iblees, he refused to be with those who prostrated.
verses.khattab: but not Iblîs, who refused to prostrate with the others
verses.jalalayn: ﻿except Iblīs, the father of the jinn — he was [standing] among the angels: he refused to be among those prostrating.
verses.romanUrdu: Siwaye Iblees ke, ke usne sajda karne walon ka saath dene se inkar kardiya

verses.uthmani: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ يٰۤاِبۡلِيۡسُ مَا لَـكَ اَلَّا تَكُوۡنَ مَعَ السّٰجِدِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: qala ya ibleesu ma laka alla takoona ma'a alssajideena
verses.saheeh: [Allah] said, O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"
verses.khattab: Allah asked, “O Iblîs! What is the matter with you that you did not join others in prostration?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, [God] exalted be He: ‘O Iblīs what is wrong with you, what prevents you, that you are not among those prostrating?’
verses.romanUrdu: Rubb ne pucha “ aey Iblis , tujhey kya hua ke tu nay sajda karne walon ka saath na diya?”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
verses.indopak: قَالَ لَمۡ اَكُنۡ لِّاَسۡجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقۡتَهٗ مِنۡ صَلۡصَالٍ مِّنۡ حَمَاٍ مَّسۡنُوۡنٍ
verses.transliteration: qala lam akun liasjuda libasharin khalaqtahu min salsalin min hamain masnoonin
verses.saheeh: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."
verses.khattab: He replied, “It is not for me to prostrate to a human You created from sounding clay moulded from black mud.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Said he, ‘I was not about to prostrate myself, I should not prostrate myself, before a mortal whom You have created out of a dry clay [drawn] from malleable mud’.
verses.romanUrdu: Usne kaha “mera yeh kaam nahin hai ke main is bashar ko sajda karoon jisey tu nay sadi hui mitti ke sookhey gaarey se paida kiya hai”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ
verses.indopak: قَالَ فَاخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَاِنَّكَ رَجِيۡمٌ ۙ
verses.transliteration: qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun
verses.saheeh: [Allah] said, "Then get out of it, for indeed, you are expelled.
verses.khattab: Allah commanded, “Then get out of Paradise, for you are truly cursed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Said He, ‘Then be gone from hence, that is, from the Garden — but it is also said, from the heavens — for you are indeed accursed, outcast.
verses.romanUrdu: Rubb ne farmaya “accha to nikal jaa yahan se kyunke tu mardood(accursed) hai

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.indopak: وَّاِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ اللَّعۡنَةَ اِلٰى يَوۡمِ الدِّيۡنِ
verses.transliteration: wainna 'alayka alla'nata ila yawmi alddeeni
verses.saheeh: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."
verses.khattab: And surely upon you is condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And indeed the curse shall rest upon you until the Day of Judgement’, [the Day] of Requital.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur ab roz-e-jaza tak tujhpar lanat hai”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ رَبِّ فَاَنۡظِرۡنِىۡۤ اِلٰى يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yub'athoona
verses.saheeh: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
verses.khattab: Satan appealed, “My Lord! Then delay my end until the Day of their resurrection.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Said he, ‘My Lord! Reprieve me until the day when they, mankind, shall be resurrected’.
verses.romanUrdu: Usne arz kiya “mere Rubb, yeh baat hai to phir mujhey us roz tak ke liye mohlat de jabke sab Insaan dobara uthaye jayenge”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ فَاِنَّكَ مِنَ الۡمُنۡظَرِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: qala fainnaka mina almunthareena
verses.saheeh: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
verses.khattab: Allah said, “You will be delayed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Said He, ‘Then lo! you are of those reprieved,
verses.romanUrdu: Farmaya “ accha, tujhey mohlat hai

verses.uthmani: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
verses.indopak: اِلٰى يَوۡمِ الۡوَقۡتِ الۡمَعۡلُوۡمِ
verses.transliteration: ila yawmi alwaqti alma'loomi
verses.saheeh: Until the Day of the time well-known."
verses.khattab: until the appointed Day.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿until the day of the known time’, the time of [the blowing of] the First Trumpet.
verses.romanUrdu: Us din tak jiska waqt humein maloom hai”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَاۤ اَغۡوَيۡتَنِىۡ لَاُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمۡ فِى الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَاُغۡوِيَـنَّهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: qala rabbi bima aghwaytanee laozayyinanna lahum fee alardi walaoghwiyannahum ajma'eena
verses.saheeh: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them on earth, and I will mislead them all
verses.khattab: Satan responded, “My Lord! For allowing me to stray I will surely tempt them on earth and mislead them all together
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Said he, ‘My Lord, because You have lead me astray (bi-mā, ‘because’, the bi- is for oaths, the response for which is [what follows]) I shall adorn for them [evil acts], acts of disobedience, in the earth and I shall lead them astray, all of them;
verses.romanUrdu: Woh bola “mere Rubb, jaisa tu nay mujhey behkaya usi tarah ab main zameen mein inke liye dil farebiyan paida karke in sabko behka dunga

verses.uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.indopak: اِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ الۡمُخۡلَصِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: illa 'ibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena
verses.saheeh: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
verses.khattab: except Your chosen servants among them.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿except those servants of Yours who are sincerely devoted [to You]’, namely, believers.
verses.romanUrdu: Siwaye tere un bandon ke jinhein tu nay inmein se khaalis karliya ho”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
verses.indopak: قَالَ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسۡتَقِيۡمٌ
verses.transliteration: qala hatha siratun 'alayya mustaqeemun
verses.saheeh: [Allah] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.
verses.khattab: Allah said, “This is the Way, binding on Me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, [God] exalted be He, said, ‘This is a straight path [leading] to Me,
verses.romanUrdu: Farmaya “yeh raasta hai jo seedha mujh tak pahunchta hai

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ عِبَادِىۡ لَـيۡسَ لَكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطٰنٌ اِلَّا مَنِ اتَّبَـعَكَ مِنَ الۡغٰوِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: inna 'ibadee laysa laka 'alayhim sultanun illa mani ittaba'aka mina alghaweena
verses.saheeh: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.
verses.khattab: you will certainly have no authority over My servants, except the deviant who follow you
verses.jalalayn: ﻿in other words, truly over My servants, that is, believers, you shall have no warrant, [no] power, except those who follow you from among the perverse, the disbelievers.
verses.romanUrdu: Beshak , jo mere haqiqi banday hain unpar tera bas na chalega. Tera bas to sirf un behke huey logon hi par chalega jo teri pairwi karein

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.indopak: وَاِنَّ جَهَـنَّمَ لَمَوۡعِدُهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: wainna jahannama lamaw'iduhum ajma'eena
verses.saheeh: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.
verses.khattab: and surely Hell is their destined place, all together
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And truly Hell shall be their tryst, all of them, that is, all those who follow you, shall be with you [in Hell].
verses.romanUrdu: Aur un sab ke liye jahannum ki waeed(destined) hai”

wbw.translation: (is) surely the promised place for them

verses.uthmani: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍۢ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌۭ مَّقْسُومٌ
verses.indopak: لَهَا سَبۡعَةُ اَبۡوَابٍ ؕ لِكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنۡهُمۡ جُزۡءٌ مَّقۡسُوۡمٌ
verses.transliteration: laha sab'atu abwabin likulli babin minhum juzon maqsoomun
verses.saheeh: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them a portion designated."
verses.khattab: It has seven gates, to each a group of them is designated.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿It has seven gates, [seven] layers — to each gate, therein, belongs an appointed portion, lot, of them.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh jahannum ( jiski waeed pairwan e Iblis ke liye ki gayi hai) uske saat (seven) darwaze hain, har darwaze keliye unmein se ek hissa makhsoos kardiya gaya hai

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ فِىۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوۡنٍ ؕ
verses.transliteration: inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wa'uyoonin
verses.saheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs.
verses.khattab: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly the God-fearing shall be amidst gardens, orchards, and springs’, flowing through them.
verses.romanUrdu: Ba-khilaf iske muttaqi log baaghon (gardens) aur chashmon (fountains) mein hongey

verses.uthmani: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.indopak: اُدۡخُلُوۡهَا بِسَلٰمٍ اٰمِنِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: odkhulooha bisalamin amineena
verses.saheeh: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."
verses.khattab: ˹It will be said to them,˺ “Enter in peace and security.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And it shall be said to them: ‘Enter them in peace, that is, safe from all danger — or [it means enter] with [the greeting of] ‘Peace!’, in other words: say, ‘Peace’ and then enter, secure!’, from all terror.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur unse kaha jayega ke dakhil ho jao inmein salamati ke saath bekhauf o khatar

verses.uthmani: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
verses.indopak: وَنَزَعۡنَا مَا فِىۡ صُدُوۡرِهِمۡ مِّنۡ غِلٍّ اِخۡوَانًا عَلٰى سُرُرٍ مُّتَقٰبِلِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: wanaza'na ma fee sudoorihim min ghillin ikhwanan 'ala sururin mutaqabileena
verses.saheeh: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.
verses.khattab: We will remove whatever bitterness they had in their hearts. In a friendly manner, they will be on thrones, facing one another
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We remove whatever rancour, spite, may be in their breasts. As brethren (ikhwānan is a circumstantial qualifier referring to them), [they shall recline] upon couches, facing one another (mutaqābilīn is also a circumstantial qualifier), in other words, they do not look upon each other’s backs, because the couches revolve with them in them.
verses.romanUrdu: Unke dilon mein jo thodi bahut khot-kapat hogi usey hum nikal denge, woh aapas mein bhai bhai bankar aamne saamne takhaton par baithenge

verses.uthmani: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
verses.indopak: لَا يَمَسُّهُمۡ فِيۡهَا نَـصَبٌ وَّمَا هُمۡ مِّنۡهَا بِمُخۡرَجِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: la yamassuhum feeha nasabun wama hum minha bimukhrajeena
verses.saheeh: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.
verses.khattab: No fatigue will touch them there, nor will they ever be asked to leave
verses.jalalayn: ﻿No toil, [no] weariness, will touch them, nor will they be expelled from thence, ever.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhein na wahan kisi mushaqqat se paala padega aur na woh wahan se nikale jayenge

verses.uthmani: نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.indopak: نَبِّئۡ عِبَادِىۡۤ اَنِّىۡۤ اَنَا الۡغَفُوۡرُ الرَّحِيۡمُ ۙ
verses.transliteration: nabbi 'ibadee annee ana alghafooru alrraheemu
verses.saheeh: [O Muhammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful.
verses.khattab: Inform My servants ˹O Prophet˺ that I am truly the All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Tell, inform, O Muhammad (s), My servants that verily I am the Forgiving, of believers, the Merciful, to them,
verses.romanUrdu: (Aey Nabi), mere bandon ko khabar de do ke main bahut darguzar karne wala (Forgiving) aur Raheem hoon

verses.uthmani: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ
verses.indopak: وَاَنَّ عَذَابِىۡ هُوَ الۡعَذَابُ الۡاَلِيۡمُ
verses.transliteration: wa anna 'athabee huwa al'athabu alaleemu
verses.saheeh: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.
verses.khattab: and that My torment is indeed the most painful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and that My chastisement, of those who are disobedient, is the painful chastisement.
verses.romanUrdu: Magar iske saath mera azaab bhi nihayat dardnaak azaab hai

verses.uthmani: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verses.indopak: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ عَنۡ ضَيۡفِ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ ۘ
verses.transliteration: wanabbihum 'an dayfi ibraheema
verses.saheeh: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,
verses.khattab: And inform them ˹O Prophet˺ about Abraham’s guests
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And tell them of the guests of Abraham, that is, the angels — there were twelve, ten or three of them, among them Gabriel;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur inhein zara Ibrahim ke mehmano ka qissa sunao

verses.uthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
verses.indopak: اِذۡ دَخَلُوۡا عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُوۡا سَلٰمًا ؕ قَالَ اِنَّا مِنۡكُمۡ وَجِلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: ith dakhaloo 'alayhi faqaloo salaman qala inna minkum wajiloona
verses.saheeh: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful of you."
verses.khattab: who entered upon him and greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” He ˹later˺ said, “Surely we are afraid of you.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[how] when they entered unto him, and said, ‘Peace!’, that is, [they said] this very word (salām). He, Abraham, said, after having offered them food which they did not eat: ‘Lo! we are afraid of you’.
verses.romanUrdu: Jab woh aaye uske haan aur kaha “Salaam ho tumpar,” to usne kaha “humein tumse darr lagta hai”

verses.uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
verses.indopak: قَالُوۡا لَا تَوۡجَلۡ اِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلٰمٍ عَلِيۡمٍ
verses.transliteration: qaloo la tawjal inna nubashshiruka bighulamin 'aleemin
verses.saheeh: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."
verses.khattab: They reassured ˹him˺, “Do not be afraid! Surely we give you good news of a knowledgeable son.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘Do not be afraid; lo!, we, are the messengers of your Lord [sent to], give you good tidings of a knowledgeable boy’, one very knowledgeable [boy], namely, Isaac — as we mentioned in sūrat Hūd [Q. 11:69].
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne jawab diya “ daro nahin, hum tumhein ek baday siyane ladke ki basharat dete hain”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ اَبَشَّرۡتُمُوۡنِىۡ عَلٰٓى اَنۡ مَّسَّنِىَ الۡكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: qala abashshartumoonee 'ala an massaniya alkibaru fabima tubashshirooni
verses.saheeh: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"
verses.khattab: He wondered, “Do you give me good news despite my old age? What unlikely news!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘Do you give me good tidings, of a boy, when old age has befallen me?’ (‘alā an massaniya l-kibaru is a circumstantial qualifier), in other words, despite the fact of its having befallen me? So, of what, thing, do you give me good tidings?’ (an interrogative meant to indicate amazement).
verses.romanUrdu: Ibrahim ne kaha “ kya tum is budhape mein mujhey aulad ki basharat dete ho? Zara socho to sahih ke yeh kaisi basharat tum mujhey de rahey ho?”

wbw.translation: Do you give me glad tidings
Do you give me glad tidings

verses.uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَٰنِطِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوۡا بَشَّرۡنٰكَ بِالۡحَـقِّ فَلَا تَكُنۡ مِّنَ الۡقٰنِطِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: qaloo bashsharnaka bialhaqqi fala takun mina alqaniteena
verses.saheeh: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."
verses.khattab: They responded, “We give you good news in all truth, so do not be one of those who despair.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘We give you good tidings in truth, sincerely; so do not be of the despairing’, the despondent.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne jawab diya “ hum tumhein bar haqq basharat de rahey hain, tum mayous na ho”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ وَمَنۡ يَّقۡنَطُ مِنۡ رَّحۡمَةِ رَبِّهٖۤ اِلَّا الضَّآلُّوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: qala waman yaqnatu min rahmati rabbihi illa alddalloona
verses.saheeh: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"
verses.khattab: He exclaimed, “Who would despair of the mercy of their Lord except the misguided?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘And who — in other words, no one — despairs (read yaqnitu or yaqnatu) of the mercy of his Lord, save those who are astray?’, [save] disbelievers.
verses.romanUrdu: Ibrahim ne kaha “ apne Rubb ki rehmat se mayous to gumraah log hi hua karte hain”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ اَيُّهَا الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona
verses.saheeh: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
verses.khattab: He ˹then˺ added, “What is your mission, O messenger-angels?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘So what is your business, O you who have been sent [by God]?’
verses.romanUrdu: Phir Ibrahim ne pucha “aey faristaad-gaan-e-Ilahi(messengers of Allah), woh mohim (expedition) kya hai jispar aap hazraat tashreef laye hain?”

verses.uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالُـوۡۤا اِنَّاۤ اُرۡسِلۡنَاۤ اِلٰى قَوۡمٍ مُّجۡرِمِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena
verses.saheeh: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,
verses.khattab: They replied, “We have actually been sent to a wicked people
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘We have been sent to a sinning folk, a disbelieving [folk], namely, the people of Lot, in order to destroy them;
verses.romanUrdu: Woh bole, “hum ek mujreem qaum ki taraf bhejhe gaye hain

verses.uthmani: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.indopak: اِلَّاۤ اٰلَ لُوۡطٍ ؕ اِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوۡهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: illa ala lootin inna lamunajjoohum ajma'eena
verses.saheeh: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all
verses.khattab: As for the family of Lot, we will certainly deliver them all
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[all] except the family of Lot; indeed we shall save them, all of them, because of their faith,
verses.romanUrdu: Sirf Lut ke ghar waley mustasna (exception) hain, un sab ko hum bacha lenge

verses.uthmani: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
verses.indopak: اِلَّا امۡرَاَتَهٗ قَدَّرۡنَاۤ ۙ اِنَّهَا لَمِنَ الۡغٰبِرِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: illa imraatahu qaddarna innaha lamina alghabireena
verses.saheeh: Except his wife." Allah decreed that she is of those who remain behind.
verses.khattab: except his wife. We have determined that she will be one of the doomed.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿except his wife — We have decreed that she indeed should be of those who will remain behind’, [of] those who will stay behind in the chastisement, because of her unbelief.
verses.romanUrdu: Siwaye uski biwi ke jiske liye (Allah farmata hai ke) humne muqaddar kardiya hai ke woh peechey reh janey walon mein shamil rahegi”

verses.uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.indopak: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ اٰلَ لُوۡطِ ۨالۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: falamma jaa ala lootin almursaloona
verses.saheeh: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,
verses.khattab: So when the messengers came to the family of Lot
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And when those who had been sent [by God] came to the family of Lot, that is, to Lot [himself],
verses.romanUrdu: Phir jab yeh Faristaade Lut ke haan pahunchey

verses.uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ اِنَّـكُمۡ قَوۡمٌ مُّنۡكَرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: qala innakum qawmun munkaroona
verses.saheeh: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."
verses.khattab: he said, “You are surely an unfamiliar people!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿he said, to them, ‘Indeed you are strangers’, that is, I do not know you.
verses.romanUrdu: To usne kaha “aap log ajnabi maloom hotey hain”

verses.uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوۡا بَلۡ جِئۡنٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوۡا فِيۡهِ يَمۡتَرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: qaloo bal jinaka bima kanoo feehi yamtaroona
verses.saheeh: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,
verses.khattab: They responded, “We have come to you with that ˹torment˺ which they have doubted
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘Rather, we have come to you because of that which they, your people, used to doubt, namely, the chastisement.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne jawab diya “nahin, balke hum wahi cheez lekar aaye hain jiske aane mein yeh log shakk kar rahey thay

verses.uthmani: وَأَتَيْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
verses.indopak: وَ اَتَيۡنٰكَ بِالۡحَـقِّ وَاِنَّا لَصٰدِقُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: waataynaka bialhaqqi wainna lasadiqoona
verses.saheeh: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.
verses.khattab: We come to you with the truth, and we are certainly truthful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And we have brought you the Truth and indeed we speak truthfully, in what we say.
verses.romanUrdu: Hum tumse sach kehte hain ke hum haqq ke saath tumhare paas aaye hain

wbw.translation: And we have come to you

verses.uthmani: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌۭ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
verses.indopak: فَاَسۡرِ بِاَهۡلِكَ بِقِطۡعٍ مِّنَ الَّيۡلِ وَاتَّبِعۡ اَدۡبَارَهُمۡ وَلَا يَلۡـتَفِتۡ مِنۡكُمۡ اَحَدٌ وَّامۡضُوۡا حَيۡثُ تُؤۡمَرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: faasri biahlika biqit'in mina allayli waittabi' adbarahum wala yaltafit minkum ahadun waimdoo haythu tumaroona
verses.saheeh: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."
verses.khattab: So travel with your family in the dark of night, and follow ˹closely˺ behind them. Do not let any of you look back, and go where you are commanded.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So travel with your family in a portion of the night and follow their rear, walk behind them; and let none of you turn round, lest he see the dreadful nature of that [punishment] which will be sent down on them, and go whither you are commanded’, namely, [to] Syria.
verses.romanUrdu: Lihaza ab tum kuch raat rahey apne ghar walon ko lekar nikal jao aur khud unke peechey peechey chalo, tum mein se koi palat kar na dekhe bas seedhey chale jao jidhar jaane ka tumhein hukum diya jaa raha hai”

verses.uthmani: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌۭ مُّصْبِحِينَ
verses.indopak: وَقَضَيۡنَاۤ اِلَيۡهِ ذٰ لِكَ الۡاَمۡرَ اَنَّ دَابِرَ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ مَقۡطُوۡعٌ مُّصۡبِحِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: waqadayna ilayhi thalika alamra anna dabira haolai maqtoo'un musbiheena
verses.saheeh: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.
verses.khattab: We revealed to him this decree: “Those ˹sinners˺ will be uprooted in the morning.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We conveyed, We revealed, to him the matter, which was, that these [sinners] was to be eradicated by morning (musbihīn is a circumstantial qualifier,), in other words, their annihilation will take place in the morning.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur usey humne apna yeh faisla pahuncha diya ke subah hotey hotey in logon ki jadd (roots) kaat di jayegi

verses.uthmani: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَجَآءَ اَهۡلُ الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ يَسۡتَـبۡشِرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: wajaa ahlu almadeenati yastabshiroona
verses.saheeh: And the people of the city came rejoicing.
verses.khattab: And there came the men of the city, rejoicing
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And then came the people of the city, the city of Sodom, that is, the people of Lot, upon being told that there were handsome clean-shaven individuals — namely, the angels — in the house of Lot, rejoicing (yastabshirūn is a circumstantial qualifier), desiring to commit an abomination with them.
verses.romanUrdu: Itne mein shehar ke log khushi ke maarey betab hokar Lut ke ghar chadh aaye

verses.uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
verses.indopak: قَالَ اِنَّ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ ضَيۡفِىۡ فَلَا تَفۡضَحُوۡنِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: qala inna haolai dayfee fala tafdahooni
verses.saheeh: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.
verses.khattab: Lot pleaded, “Indeed, these are my guests, so do not embarrass me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, Lot, said, ‘Lo! these are my guests, so do not disgrace me;
verses.romanUrdu: Lut ne kaha “bhaiyon, yeh mere mehmaan hain, meri fazihat (dishonour) na karo

verses.uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
verses.indopak: وَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَلَا تُخۡزُوۡنِ
verses.transliteration: waittaqoo allaha wala tukhzooni
verses.saheeh: And fear Allah and do not disgrace me."
verses.khattab: Fear Allah and do not humiliate me.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and fear God, and do not humiliate me’, by seeking them to commit an abomination with them.
verses.romanUrdu: Allah se daro, mujhey ruswa na karo”

verses.uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالُـوۡۤا اَوَلَمۡ نَـنۡهَكَ عَنِ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: qaloo awalam nanhaka 'ani al'alameena
verses.saheeh: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"
verses.khattab: They responded, “Have we not forbidden you from protecting anyone?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘Have we not forbidden you from [entertaining] anyone?’, from offering them hospitality?
verses.romanUrdu: Woh boley “kya hum baaraha tumhein mana nahin kar chuke hain ke duniya bhar ke thekedar na bano?”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ بَنٰتِىۡۤ اِنۡ كُنۡـتُمۡ فٰعِلِيۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: qala haolai banatee in kuntum fa'ileena
verses.saheeh: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."
verses.khattab: He said, “O my people! Here are my daughters ˹so marry them˺ if you wish to do so.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘These here are my daughters, if you must be doing’, what you desire [to do] in the way of satisfying your lust, then marry them. God, exalted be He, says:
verses.romanUrdu: Lut ne aajiz hokar kaha “agar tumhein kuch karna hi hai to yeh meri betiyan maujood hain”

verses.uthmani: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.indopak: لَعَمۡرُكَ اِنَّهُمۡ لَفِىۡ سَكۡرَتِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: la'amruka innahum lafee sakratihim ya'mahoona
verses.saheeh: By your life, [O Muhammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.
verses.khattab: By your life ˹O Prophet˺, they certainly wandered blindly, intoxicated ˹by lust˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿By your life — this is an address to the Prophet (s) — in their drunkenness they were bewildered, hesitant.
verses.romanUrdu: Teri jaan ki kasam aey Nabi, us waqt unpar ek nasha sa chadha hua tha jismein woh aape se bahar huye jatey thay

verses.uthmani: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
verses.indopak: فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الصَّيۡحَةُ مُشۡرِقِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: faakhathathumu alssayhatu mushriqeena
verses.saheeh: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.
verses.khattab: So the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them at sunrise
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then the Cry, the Cry of Gabriel, seized them at sunrise.
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir e kaar pow phathte hi unko ek zabardast dhamake ne aa liya (severe blast overtook them at dawn)

verses.uthmani: فَجَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
verses.indopak: فَجَعَلۡنَا عَالِيـَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَ اَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةً مِّنۡ سِجِّيۡلٍ ؕ
verses.transliteration: faja'alna 'aliyaha safilaha waamtarna 'alayhim hijaratan min sijjeelin
verses.saheeh: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.
verses.khattab: And We turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down and rained upon them stones of baked clay
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We made their, that is, their cities’, topmost part their nethermost, by Gabriel’s raising them [the cities] to the heaven and dropping them face down onto the earth, and We rained on them stones of baked clay, clay baked in fire.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur humne us basti ko talpat karke rakh diya aur unpar paki (baked) hui mitti ke pattharon ki baarish barsa di

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰ لِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّـلۡمُتَوَسِّمِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: inna fee thalika laayatin lilmutawassimeena
verses.saheeh: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.
verses.khattab: Surely in this are signs for those who contemplate
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed in that, which is mentioned, there are signs, indications of God’s Oneness, for those who take note, [those who] observe and take heed.
verses.romanUrdu: Is waqiye mein badi nishaniyan hain un logon ke liye jo saahib-e-firasat hain

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍۢ مُّقِيمٍ
verses.indopak: وَاِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيۡلٍ مُّقِيۡمٍ
verses.transliteration: wainnaha labisabeelin muqeemin
verses.saheeh: And indeed, those cities are [situated] on an established road.
verses.khattab: Their ruins still lie along a known route
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And indeed they, that is, the cities of the people of Lot, are on a road that [still] remains, Quraysh’s route to Syria, [one] not yet effaced: so why do they not take heed from their example?
verses.romanUrdu: Aur woh ilaqa (jahan yeh waqiya pesh aaya tha) guzar gaah e aam (high way) par waqeh hai

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّـلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: inna fee thalika laayatan lilmumineena
verses.saheeh: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
verses.khattab: Surely in this is a sign for those who believe
verses.jalalayn: ﻿There is indeed a sign, a lesson, in that for believers.
verses.romanUrdu: Usmein samaan e ibrat hai un logon ke liye jo sahib e iman hain

verses.uthmani: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.indopak: وَاِنۡ كَانَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡاَيۡكَةِ لَظٰلِمِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: wain kana ashabu alaykati lathalimeena
verses.saheeh: And the companions of the thicket were [also] wrongdoers.
verses.khattab: And the residents of the Forest were truly wrongdoers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And certainly (in has been softened, in other words [understand it as being] innahu) the dwellers in the wood, a huddle of trees near Midian — these were the people of [the prophet] Shu‘ayb — were evildoers, for denying Shu‘ayb.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Aikah waley zalim thay

verses.uthmani: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.indopak: فَانتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ ۘ وَاِنَّهُمَا لَبِاِمَامٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ ؕ
verses.transliteration: faintaqamna minhum wainnahuma labiimamin mubeenin
verses.saheeh: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.
verses.khattab: so We inflicted punishment upon them. The ruins of both nations still lie on a well-known road
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So We exacted retribution from them, by destroying them through extreme heat. And certainly both of them, that is, the cities of the people of Lot and those of [the dwellers in] the wood, are upon a open road, plain [to see]: so will you not take heed from their example, O people of Mecca?
verses.romanUrdu: To dekhlo ke humne unsey bhi inteqam liya, aur in dono qaumon ke ujade huey ilaqe khuley raaste par waqeh hain

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.indopak: وَلَـقَدۡ كَذَّبَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡحِجۡرِ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: walaqad kaththaba ashabu alhijri almursaleena
verses.saheeh: And certainly did the companions of Thamud deny the messengers.
verses.khattab: Indeed, the residents of the Stone Valley also denied the messengers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily the dwellers in al-Hijr — a valley between Medina and Syria — namely, [the tribe of] Thamūd, denied those who had been sent [by God], when they denied [the prophet] Sālih, as this constituted a denial of the other messengers, since they all shared the fact that they came with [the Message proclaiming] the Oneness of God.
verses.romanUrdu: Hijr ke log bhi Rasoolon ki takzeeb kar chuke hain

verses.uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.indopak: وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ اٰيٰتِنَا فَكَانُوۡا عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: waataynahum ayatina fakanoo 'anha mu'rideena
verses.saheeh: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.
verses.khattab: We gave them Our signs, but they turned away from them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We brought them Our signs, by way of the she-camel [of Sālih], but they were averse [to them], refusing to reflect on them.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne apni aayat unke paas bheji, apni nishaniyan unko dikhayi, magar woh sabko nazar-andaz (ignore) hi karte rahey

verses.uthmani: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
verses.indopak: وَكَانُوۡا يَنۡحِتُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡجِبَالِ بُيُوۡتًا اٰمِنِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: wakanoo yanhitoona mina aljibali buyootan amineena
verses.saheeh: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.
verses.khattab: They carved their homes in the mountains, feeling secure
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they used to hew out dwellings from the mountains, feeling secure.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh pahad tarash tarash kar makaan banate thay aur apni jagah bilkul be-khauf aur mutmaeen thay

verses.uthmani: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
verses.indopak: فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الصَّيۡحَةُ مُصۡبِحِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: faakhathathumu alssayhatu musbiheena
verses.saheeh: But the shriek seized them at early morning.
verses.khattab: But the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them in the morning
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But the Cry seized them in the morning.
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir e kaar ek zabardast dhamake ne unko subah hotey hi aa liya

verses.uthmani: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.indopak: فَمَاۤ اَغۡنٰى عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: fama aghna 'anhum ma kanoo yaksiboona
verses.saheeh: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.
verses.khattab: and all they achieved was of no help to them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And so that which they used to count as gain, in the way of building fortresses and amassing riches, did not avail, [did not] protect, them, from the chastisement.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur unki kamayi unke kuch kaam na aayi

verses.uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌۭ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
verses.indopak: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۤ اِلَّا بِالۡحَـقِّ ؕ وَاِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَاٰتِيَةٌ فَاصۡفَحِ الصَّفۡحَ الۡجَمِيۡلَ
verses.transliteration: wama khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma illa bialhaqqi wainna alssa'ata laatiyatun faisfahi alssafha aljameela
verses.saheeh: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.
verses.khattab: We have not created the heavens and the earth and everything in between except for a purpose. And the Hour is certain to come, so forgive graciously
verses.jalalayn: ﻿We did not create the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with the Truth. And truly the Hour shall come, without doubt, whereupon every person will be requited according to his deeds. So be forgiving, O Muhammad (s), to your people, with gracious forgiveness: turn away from them without [any feeling of] anxiety — this was abrogated by the ‘sword’ verse [Q. 9:5].
verses.romanUrdu: Humne zameen aur aasman ko aur unki sab maujoodaat ko haqq ke siwa kisi aur buniyaad par khalq (create) nahin kiya hai, aur faisle ki ghadi yaqeenan aane wali hai. Pas (aey Muhammad), tum (in logon ki behudgiyon par) shareefana darguzar se kaam lo

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الۡخَـلّٰقُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
verses.transliteration: inna rabbaka huwa alkhallaqu al'aleemu
verses.saheeh: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.
verses.khattab: Surely your Lord is the Master Creator, All-Knowing
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly your Lord, He is the Creator, of everything, the Knowing, of everything.
verses.romanUrdu: Yaqeenan tumahra Rubb sab ka khaliq hai aur sab kuch jaanta hai

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ سَبْعًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
verses.indopak: وَلَـقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنٰكَ سَبۡعًا مِّنَ الۡمَـثَانِىۡ وَالۡـقُرۡاٰنَ الۡعَظِيۡمَ
verses.transliteration: walaqad ataynaka sab'an mina almathanee waalqurana al'atheema
verses.saheeh: And We have certainly given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur'an.
verses.khattab: We have certainly granted you the seven often-repeated verses and the great Quran
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We have given you seven of the oft-repeated [verses] — the Prophet (s) said that this meant [sūrat] al-Fātiha, as reported by the two Shaykhs [Bukhārī and Muslim], since it is repeated in every unit of prayer (rak‘a) — and the great Qur'an.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne tumko saat (seven) aisi aayatein de rakkhi hain jo baar baar dohrayi janey ke layiq hain, aur tumhein Quran e azeem ata kiya hai

verses.uthmani: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ اِلٰى مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهٖۤ اَزۡوَاجًا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَاخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: la tamuddanna 'aynayka ila ma matta'na bihi azwajan minhum wala tahzan 'alayhim waikhfid janahaka lilmumineena
verses.saheeh: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of the disbelievers, and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing to the believers
verses.khattab: Do not let your eyes crave the ˹fleeting˺ pleasures We have provided for some of the disbelievers, nor grieve for them. And be gracious to the believers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Do not extend your glance toward that which We have given different groups of them to enjoy, and do not grieve for them, should they not believe, and lower your wing, temper your nature, for the believers.
verses.romanUrdu: Tum us mata-e-duniya ki taraf aankh utha kar na dekho jo humne in mein se mukhtalif qisam ke logon ko de rakkhi hai, aur na inke haal par apna dil kudhao(grieve), inhein chodh kar iman laney walon ki taraf jhuko

verses.uthmani: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.indopak: وَقُلۡ اِنِّىۡۤ اَنَا النَّذِيۡرُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ ۚ
verses.transliteration: waqul innee ana alnnatheeru almubeenu
verses.saheeh: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -
verses.khattab: And say, “I am truly sent with a clear warning”—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And say: ‘Indeed, I am the warner, of God’s chastisement, lest it be sent down on you, the clear [warner], clear in [his] warning.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur (na maanne walon se) kehdo ke main to saaf saaf tambeeh(warn) karne wala hoon

verses.uthmani: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
verses.indopak: كَمَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَى الۡمُقۡتَسِمِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: kama anzalna 'ala almuqtasimeena
verses.saheeh: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators
verses.khattab: ˹a warning˺ similar to what We sent to those who divided ˹the Scriptures˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Even as We sent down, chastisement, on those who make division, the Jews and the Christians,
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh usi ki tarah ki tambeeh hai jaisi humne un tafarraqe pardazon(those who make division) ki taraf bheji thi

verses.uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
verses.indopak: الَّذِيۡنَ جَعَلُوا الۡـقُرۡاٰنَ عِضِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: allatheena ja'aloo alqurana 'ideena
verses.saheeh: Who have made the Qur'an into portions.
verses.khattab: who ˹now˺ accept parts of the Quran, rejecting others
verses.jalalayn: ﻿those who have reduced the Recitation, namely, those scriptures revealed to them, to parts, believing in some and disbelieving in others. It is [alternatively] said that the individuals meant here were those who ‘divided up’ among themselves the roads to Mecca, barring people from Islam. Some of them said that the Qur'an was sorcery, some that it was soothsaying, and others that it was poetry.
verses.romanUrdu: Jinhon ne apne Quran ko tukde tukde kar dala hai

verses.uthmani: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.indopak: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَـنَسۡــَٔلَـنَّهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: fawarabbika lanasalannahum ajma'eena
verses.saheeh: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
verses.khattab: So by your Lord! We will certainly question them all
verses.jalalayn: ﻿By your Lord, We shall question them all — a questioning involving rebuke —
verses.romanUrdu: To kasam hai tere Rubb ki, hum zaroor in sabse puchenge

verses.uthmani: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.indopak: عَمَّا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: 'amma kanoo ya'maloona
verses.saheeh: About what they used to do.
verses.khattab: about what they used to do
verses.jalalayn: ﻿about what they used to do.
verses.romanUrdu: Ke tum kya karte rahey ho

verses.uthmani: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.indopak: فَاصۡدَعۡ بِمَا تُؤۡمَرُ وَ اَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: faisda' bima tumaru waa'rid 'ani almushrikeena
verses.saheeh: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.
verses.khattab: So proclaim what you have been commanded, and turn away from the polytheists
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So proclaim, O Muhammad (s), what you have been commanded, to [proclaim], in other words, declare it openly and carry it out, and turn away from the idolaters — this was [revealed] before the command to struggle [against the idolaters].
verses.romanUrdu: Pas (aey Nabi) jis cheez ka tumhein hukum diya jaa raha hai usey hankey pukare kehdo(proclaim publicly) aur shirk karne walon ki zara parwah na karo

verses.uthmani: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّا كَفَيۡنٰكَ الۡمُسۡتَهۡزِءِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: inna kafaynaka almustahzieena
verses.saheeh: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
verses.khattab: Surely We will be sufficient for you against the mockers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed We have sufficed you against the mockers, [who mocked] you, by Our having destroyed each one of them through some harm, and these were: al-Walīd b. al-Mughīra, al-‘Āsī b. Wā’il, ‘Udayy b. Qays, al-Aswad b. al-Muttalib and al-Aswad b. ‘Abd Yaghūth,
verses.romanUrdu: Tumhari taraf se hum un mazaaq udane walon ki khabar lenay ke liye kafi hain

verses.uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.indopak: الَّذِيۡنَ يَجۡعَلُوۡنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ ۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: allatheena yaj'aloona ma'a allahi ilahan akhara fasawfa ya'lamoona
verses.saheeh: Who make [equal] with Allah another deity. But they are going to know.
verses.khattab: who set up ˹other˺ gods with Allah. They will soon come to know
verses.jalalayn: ﻿those [mockers] who set up besides God another god: (this [entire clause] is an adjectival qualification; but it is also said to be the subject, and because there is an implicit conditional meaning [in the above-mentioned clause], the [particle] fā’ has been inserted into the predicate, which is [the following]) soon they will know, the sequel of their affair.
verses.romanUrdu: Jo Allah ke saath kisi aur ko bhi khuda qarar dete hain anqareeb unhein maloom ho jayega

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَـقَدۡ نَـعۡلَمُ اَنَّكَ يَضِيۡقُ صَدۡرُكَ بِمَا يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: walaqad na'lamu annaka yadeequ sadruka bima yaqooloona
verses.saheeh: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
verses.khattab: We certainly know that your heart is truly distressed by what they say
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily (wa-laqad is for confirmation) We know that your breast is [at times] oppressed by what they say, in the way of mockery and denial.
verses.romanUrdu: Humein maloom hai ke jo baatein yeh log tumpar banate hain unsey tumhare dil ko sakht koft hoti hai (heart is distressed)

verses.uthmani: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
verses.indopak: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُنۡ مِّنَ السّٰجِدِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wakun mina alssajideena
verses.saheeh: So exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].
verses.khattab: So glorify the praises of your Lord and be one of those who ˹always˺ pray
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So glorify, intimately [repeating], the praise of your Lord, in other words, say subhāna’Llāhi wa-bi-hamdihi — and be of those who prostrate themselves, those who pray;
verses.romanUrdu: Iska ilaaj yeh hai ke apne Rubb ki hamd ke saath uski tasbeeh karo, uski janaab mein sajda baja lao

verses.uthmani: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
verses.indopak: وَاعۡبُدۡ رَبَّكَ حَتّٰى يَاۡتِيَكَ الۡيَـقِيۡنُ
verses.transliteration: wao'bud rabbaka hatta yatiyaka alyaqeenu
verses.saheeh: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death).
verses.khattab: and worship your Lord until the inevitable comes your way
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and worship your Lord until Certainty — Death — comes to you.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur us aakhri ghadi tak apne Rubb ki bandagi karte raho jiska aana yaqeeni hai
